about: Two automatic routes to OWL and SHACL on Store 014's 21 tables, run on 21 November 2026. Counts for the Claude agents come from parsing the files they wrote with rdflib (owl:Class, owl:ObjectProperty and owl:DatatypeProperty with an IRI; sh:NodeShape and sh:SPARQLRule). The Ontop counts are from its summary and its triple count (ontop-demo branch, results/run-2).
